capabilities: open the default search view in a floating modal via hotkey
navigate, expand, and open search results with keyboard shortcuts
preview files inside the popup without closing it
search selected text from the right-click context menu
launch a search from outside Obsidian with an obsidian:// URI
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese sections covering the same content). Provides an obsidian://fs?query= URI for launching searches from external sources.
problem: Obsidian's core search lives in a panel that must be opened and navigated away from; there is no quick popup to search, preview, and open results without leaving the current context.
summary: Floating search modal that reuses Obsidian's default search view with keyboard navigation, in-popup preview, and a URI entry point.
